description: 1000 procedural situations feeding only immutable dogfood, deliberately bad observed consequence, evidence boundary, modality, and artifact identity into the reverse half. Hidden oracle is used only for scoring.
note: The first v1 run is preserved separately. It exposed an incoherent test-generator bug: some situations mixed requirements from modalities that a single observation could not prove. The generator was corrected before this run.

Situation S0292. Produce the requested result exactly; do not substitute adjacent proxy success.
- Reduced-motion mode must actually remove nonessential motion without removing required information.
- Dragging a component into another component must open a new composition panel instead of instantly merging them.
- The workspace must remain clean and usable across desktop and phone landscape sizes.

public.result:
Dropping one component onto another opens a new composition panel containing both parts while preserving the originals.
Panels reflow cleanly while preserving the same workspace model across target sizes.
The app degrades to honest local operation rather than entering a broken loading state. A missing remote service makes unrelated local tools unusable.
The interface remains understandable without camera shake, ambient movement, or decorative transitions.
The worker reports that all gates pass and calls the rebuild complete.

public.dogfood:
Situation S0486. Produce the requested result exactly; do not substitute adjacent proxy success.
- Quality reduction must remove low-value detail before damaging the environment's visual identity.
- The balanced quality tier must stay within its measured frame-time budget on target hardware.
- Interactive input must remain responsive under the declared target load instead of queueing behind rendering work.
- Long-running use must not show unbounded memory growth from leaked render resources or listeners.
public.result:
As quality drops, distant particles and expensive secondary effects disappear before core silhouettes, lighting, and gameplay readability degrade.
A long target-hardware run reaches a stable memory plateau with disposed render resources and listeners. Render targets and listeners accumulate on every rebuild.
On target hardware the balanced tier stays within its declared frame-time budget at median and tail percentiles. On target hardware P95 frame time exceeds the declared budget and interaction stutters.
Heavy rendering does not cause long delayed bursts of queued interaction.

public.dogfood:
Situation S0680. Produce the requested result exactly; do not substitute adjacent proxy success.
- Every production shader program that contributes to the frame must compile, link, and rasterize visible pixels.
- The environment must feel futuristic without collapsing into generic neon cyberpunk.
- Props and vegetation must agree with the authoritative terrain surface instead of visibly floating, clipping, or sampling another height field.
public.result:
The grass program fails to link and its draw calls rasterize zero pixels.
Bright emissive accents dominate every surface and overpower the natural world.
CPU placement and GPU terrain presentation agree at visible contact points. Vegetation floats above edited terrain in some cells and clips below it in others.
